stats.label: Selection stability

notes: Candidates are ranked on each training window and only the winner is carried into the test window, so the selection never sees the data it is judged on. The curve is the chained test segments.
The winner changed across folds (stability 60%). A selection rule that keeps changing its mind is usually fitting noise, and the stitched result carries that instability.
